body: Budget 2025 Working for Families - Abatement Changes raises the family-income abatement threshold from NZ$42,700 to NZ$44,900 and raises the abatement rate from 27 percent to 27.5 percent from 1 April 2026. The Summary of Initiatives reports an operating total of NZ$205 million across the forecast period. The signed fiscal recommendation decomposes the total across Family Tax Credit, In-Work Tax Credit, Minimum Family Tax Credit, and debt-impairment lines.

Budget 2026 Increase to the In-Work Tax Credit in Response to the Conflict in the Middle East raises the maximum in-work tax credit by NZ$50 per week from 1 April 2026 through 31 March 2027, subject to an earlier petrol-price termination condition. Inland Revenue expresses the annual maximum as an increase from NZ$5,070 to NZ$7,670, reverting to NZ$5,070 after 31 March 2027. The Summary of Initiatives reports an operating total of NZ$373 million across the forecast period.
